title: ReadVersion
description: A version of a part of an engine's installation, as `GET /engines/:engine/installation` reads it (plan 13, B-11) — or why there is none, in the engine's own open-ended words. Never a failure. Distinct from `ComponentVersion` (diag's, with a closed two-value reason): this `reason` is whatever string the installation facts read off the engine, not one of a fixed set.

reason.description: Why there is no version — open-ended, unlike `ComponentVersion`'s.
